name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
August 12, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - President Jess Martinez, of the Vista California Stake of the Church of Jesus Christ Latter Day Saints
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
Recommended Action:
There are no presentations scheduled on this agenda.*3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinance (CC)
C5.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending May 31, 2008 (CC)
C6.
Opposition to State Utilization of Local Government, Redevelopment and Transportation Funding (CC)
C7.
Disadvantaged Business Enterprise Program (CC)
C8.
Supplemental Agreement with the Vista Fire Protection District (CC)
C9.
Acceptance of Offer of Dedication and Setting Public Hearing Date for Street Vacation of 1530 and 1546 Tierra Del Cielo (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , accepting a portion of the Irrevocable Offer of Dedication recorded April 24, 1979, at File/Page 79-167701 APNs 174-32-09 and 10; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , declaring its intent to initiate proceedings to vacate a public street easement at 1530 and 1546 Tierra Del Cielo.
C10.
Agreement with Zasueta Contracting, Inc. for Playground Equipment (CC)
C11.
Time Limit and Passenger Loading Zones on Escondido Avenue (CC)
C12.
All-Way Stop on Date Street at Huff Street (CC)
C13.
N. Santa Fe Avenue and S. Melrose Drive Traffic Signal Interconnect (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the design of the N. Santa Fe Avenue Traffic Signal Interconnect project; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the design of the S. Melrose Drive Traffic Signal Interconnect project.
C14.
No Parking Zones on Huff Street and W. Vista Way (CC)
C15.
New Speed Zone Sections without Speed Limit Change on North Avenue/North Drive, W. Los Angeles Drive, and Townsite Drive (CC)
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed limit of 30 Miles Per Hour on North Avenue / North Drive between N. Melrose Drive and W. Los Angeles Drive";
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed limit of 25 Miles Per Hour on W. Los Angeles Drive between North Drive and N. Santa Fe Avenue"; and
3.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Establishing a Prima Facie Speed limit of 25 Miles Per Hour on Townsite Drive between N. Santa Fe Avenue and E. Vista Way."
C16.
Property Exchange with Vista Unified School District (VUSD) (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
November 4, 2008, General Municipal Election (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , calling a General Municipal Election and requesting the Board of Supervisors to consolidate the election with the Statewide General Election; and
2.
If the City Council desires, adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , providing for the conduct of a Special Runoff Election in the event of a tie vote.
D2.
Agreement for Administration of the Vistans Revitalizing Our Community (R.O.C.) Project (CDC)
D3.
Redevelopment Plan Amendment Resetting the Base Year, Adoption of Owner Participation Rules and Method of Relocation (CDC)
1.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , Resetting the Base Year Assessment Roll to be used for amendment No. 4 to the Vista Redevelopment Project; and
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2008- , adopting by reference Rules Governing Participation by Owners of Real Property and Persons Engaged in Business in the Vista Redevelopment Project Area and Method of Relocation for the Vista Redevelopment Project Area.
D4.
2008 Sewer Master Plan Update and Program Environmental Impact Report (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , certifying the Final Program Environmental Impact Report prepared for the 2008 Sewer Master Plan Update,
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , certifying a Final Program Environmental Impact Report for the 2008 Sewer Master Plan Update;
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the 2008 Sewer Master Plan Update; and
4.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2008- , approving the 2008 Sewer Master Plan Update.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
Recommended Action:
There are no public hearings scheduled on this agenda.*3
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
